audit.why: 51.61% over 558 games with diff EVEN 6/10 matches a lane Olaf owns in stages and Neeko takes back at 6 and on picks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf, which contradicts the packet chart, the mirror audit, and five of the seven whys sitting under the rows — whys[0] says Olaf wins first contact, whys[2] says level 3 is even, whys[3] says 4-5 is his, whys[4] names 6 as her window, whys[5] calls first item a skill fight.
audit.why: Neeko has no escape at 1 and a squishy bar; Olaf's takeover stages are 1, 2, 4-5 and two items, and her only stage is 6 with Pop Blossom off a clone.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Olaf, Neeko, Skill, Olaf, with ratings moved on the rows that changed hands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect confirmed: the full layer never names one Neeko ability except Tangle-Barbs, and it tells the player 'his Tangle-Barbs can't stop Ragnarok' — which points the ultimate at the wrong spell. Tangle-Barbs is a 12s root; Pop Blossom is the 120s AoE knockup-and-stun whose wind-up is hidden while she is disguised. Spending R on the root leaves nothing for the ult.
audit.why: The content layer already had this right ('hold R for her R'); the full layer said the opposite, so the two halves of the page gave contradictory instructions on the only decision that matters at 6.
audit.corrected: Full layer re-pointed: Ragnarok held for Pop Blossom, Tangle-Barbs dodged rather than ulted through. Blooming Burst named as the 800-range poke that blooms twice, Shapesplitter named as the clone and the every-third-attack passive, Tangle-Barbs given its 12s and 1000 range plus the growth on passing a champion. Undertow named with its 9s pickup reset, Reckless Swing as the 325-range true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neeko referred to as 'he/his' throughout the full layer.
audit.why: Neeko is female; the content layer already uses 'she'.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the lines being rewritten.

audit.why: The kit tags Undertow with 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes' and that would make it a clean answer to Pop Blossom's leap. Riot's own Undertow text is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only — no grounding.
audit.corrected: No grounding or dash-denial claim written; the mirror reached the same conclusion.

notes: The two layers of this page disagreed about what Ragnarok is for. The content layer says hold R for Pop Blossom (correct — Tangle-Barbs is a 12s root, Pop Blossom is the 120s stun with a wind-up hidden by disguise); the full layer's tldr and winCon told the player his root 'can't stop Ragnarok', which points a 100s ultimate at the cheap spell. Full layer re-pointed to match. Also fixed male pronouns for Neeko throughout the full layer, and named the four abilities the packet flagged as never mentioned. DERIVED-FLAG MISFIRE, deliberately not written: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding/dash-denial, which would make it an answer to Pop Blossom's leap, but Riot's Undertow text is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only — no such claim written, same call as the mirror.
